children: may retest a support at $90.35 per barrel, a break below which could open the way toward the $88.66 to $89.18 range.
Despite stabilizing twice around $90.35, the market did not bounce above a resistance at $93.06. The weak bounce signals a prevailing bearish momentum and a steady downtrend.
The pattern from $89.16 looks like a head-and-shoulders, which suggests a target around $86. A break above $93.06 would confirm a small double-bottom and a target of $95.23.
On the daily chart, as long as the contract remains below a resistance at $93.93, it is expected to resume its downtrend.

A break above this level could trigger a gain into the $96.57 to $99.63 range. Even such a gain would not be considered a reversal of the downtrend, as it could merely represent the second leg of a three-wave cycle from $118.13.
